name: facebookresearch_lama/lama/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_lama/lama/build_encoded.encode_sentences: encode a list of sentences into contextual embeddings using a language model and return an EncodedDataset
facebookresearch_lama/lama/build_encoded.load_encoded_dataset: load a precomputed EncodedDataset from a pickle file at the given path
facebookresearch_lama/lama/build_encoded.create_encoded_dataset: create an EncodedDataset object from a list of encoded sentence tuples with embeddings and lengths
facebookresearch_lama/lama/build_encoded.save_encoded_dataset: save an EncodedDataset to disk as a pickle file at the specified path
facebookresearch_lama/lama/build_encoded.aggregate_layers: average embeddings across all model layers to produce a single aggregated embedding tensor

facebookresearch_lama/lama/evaluation_me.get_ranking: get the ranking metrics MRR, P@X, and perplexity for masked language model predictions using log_probs and masked_indices
facebookresearch_lama/lama/evaluation_me.get_negation_metric: get the negation overlap and Spearman rank correlation between affirmative and negated masked language model predictions
facebookresearch_lama/lama/evaluation_me.max_probs_values_indices: extract the top-k maximum log probability values and their indices from masked language model output tensors
facebookresearch_lama/lama/evaluation_me.print_top_k: print and return the top-k predicted token word forms with their log probabilities from a vocabulary
facebookresearch_lama/lama/evaluation_me.overlap_negation: compute whether the top-ranked prediction is identical between an affirmative and its negated masked statement

facebookresearch_lama/lama/options.py.run_general_parser: run get_general_parser to create an argparse parser with language model and BERT ELMo GPT arguments
facebookresearch_lama/lama/options.py.run_eval_generation_parser: run get_eval_generation_parser to create a parser for text generation evaluation with sentence splitting
facebookresearch_lama/lama/options.py.run_eval_KB_completion_parser: run get_eval_KB_completion_parser to create a parser for knowledge base completion evaluation with batch settings
facebookresearch_lama/lama/options.py.run_parse_args: run parse_args on a parser to parse CLI arguments and validate model-specific required options
facebookresearch_lama/lama/options.py.run_add_bert_args: run __add_bert_args to add BERT model directory and vocabulary arguments to an existing parser

facebookresearch_lama/lama/utils.py.print_sentence_predictions: print sentence-level token predictions with perplexity scores and top-k ranking for a language model
facebookresearch_lama/lama/utils.py.load_vocab: load a vocabulary file into a list of token strings from a given file path
facebookresearch_lama/lama/utils.py.review_print_sentence_predictions: review the print_sentence_predictions function to understand how it computes perplexity and ranks token predictions
facebookresearch_lama/lama/utils.py.refactor_print_sentence_predictions: refactor print_sentence_predictions to support multiple masked indices instead of only the first
facebookresearch_lama/lama/utils.py.summarize_load_vocab: summarize the load_vocab function that reads a text file and returns stripped token strings
